source_text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
child_paraphrase: God looked at everything He had made, and it was very good.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 7 required an exact source from the Genesis 1 / Psalm 19 theme. Genesis 1:31 is locked because the mission is God's Beautiful Creation and this verse states that everything God made was very good. Psalm 19:1 was not used; its heavens/firmament theme overlaps Mission 2 (Genesis 1:14).
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
Do not treat deer, creeks, or other nature props as named facts from this verse
Do not add the rest of the creation week, names, or events that are not in Genesis 1:31
